audit: BN-005 Deployment Hardening, Scoping, and History Verification

verifies: Default RoutingServiceConfig fails validate_deployment without explicit dev override
Config with internal_service_token but missing durable journals fails validate_deployment
Non-loopback bind without internal_service_token is unconditionally refused
Unauthenticated calls to /internal/routing/v1/health, /speakers, /peers, /routes, /events return HTTP 401 Unauthorized
Missing or invalid x-bonsai-routing-token returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized with unauthorized_internal_client error
Correct x-bonsai-routing-token returns HTTP 200 OK
Public web router fails closed by default requiring auth for /api/*
Public /health liveness probe remains accessible without auth
Valid JWT / API key authenticates requests
Cross-speaker GET /api/routing/v1/routes is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden (routing_scope_violation)
Cross-VRF GET /api/routing/v1/routes is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden (routing_scope_violation)
Cross-tenant GET /api/routing/v1/routes is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden (routing_scope_violation)
Valid unscoped GET /api/routing/v1/routes automatically injects identity-derived filters
Cross-speaker POST /api/routing/v1/adjudicate-prefix is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden (routing_scope_violation)
Cross-speaker POST /api/investigations is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden

GET /api/investigations returns only investigations matching the caller's scoped speaker
Rejects all Cypher mutation keywords: CREATE, DELETE, MERGE, DROP, ALTER, COPY, LOAD, FOREACH, IMPORT, EXPORT

Accepts valid read queries containing comments

RibEventJournal::all_events() reads all 1,200 events without truncating at early limit
RibEventJournal::latest_events(50) retrieves newest events preserving latest evidence
